caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern composed of five large, stylized leaf or plume motifs arranged in a diamond formation, with one motif in the center and four motifs at the corners. Each motif is rendered in shades of light blue with darker blue accents and outlines, and each has a white highlight for emphasis. The background is a light tan or beige color, filling the square area of the design. Intersecting diagonal lines made up of delicate, thin, dark branches with small, round, dark blue or gray flowers run through the image, forming a lattice or trellis structure that aligns with the placement of the larger motifs. The design is framed with a thin, off-white border, and the overall composition is symmetrical and evenly spaced.
title: Wallpaper
